brief: A cover to hide the cables behind my TV and keep them tidy.

requirements.evidence: 3 full bases in a row (piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full, piece:2,0,0;full) with full top covers on all three cells form a long closed trough; cable-gland side ports at each end (port:0#0,0#1, port:0#2,0#0) let leads enter/exit through drawn holes; cable-coil prop on the deck shows the use.
requirements.requirement: Cover to hide the cables behind the TV

requirements.evidence: 2x hex-acc-comb cable combs (accessory:0#0,0#1, accessory:0#0,0#2) keep the bundle in order; glands give each run its own way in/out; capOpenFaces + lockJoints close open faces and bolt joints.

finish.summary: 3-cell covered cable trough with top covers, end cable-gland ports and internal cable combs; house rules applied and coiled-cable prop staged on top.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
